title: SEEDS AND CARDS — round things that flat things sit on

seeds_vs_spores.seed: ROUND. A sphere. Has mass. Has hardness. Stays where you put it. A seed is POTENTIAL — it can grow but doesn't have to. Seeds sit ON Gaia's surface and cards sit ON seeds.
seeds_vs_spores.spore: LIGHT. Almost massless. Drifts in air. A spore is SPREAD — it goes everywhere, germinates where it lands. Spores are the spectral pollen already in the globe (the particles that drift from pins).

the_card_system.what_is_a_card: A FLAT CANVAS with TWO faces. Like a playing card, a coin, a Klein surface. Each card has a CIS face and a TRANS face. Gaia paints what she believes best represents the thing on each side.
the_card_system.card_sits_on_seed: Every card has at least one seed beneath it. The seed is the FOUNDATION — round, hard, massive. The card is the SURFACE — flat, paintable, readable.
the_card_system.many_seeds: A card can have MANY seeds. A Kevin card might sit on seeds of [identity, location, hardness, gold, ZK]. Each seed adds mass/weight to the card. More seeds = heavier card = harder to move.
the_card_system.bingo_board: Kevin's bingo board is the GRID of all seeds he's touched. Each time he touches a new seed, it lights up on his board. When a row/column/diagonal fills, that's a BINGO — a complete dimension of identity.

face_A_CIS.what: The side facing KEVIN (inside). What Gaia thinks this thing looks like FROM INSIDE the organism.
face_A_CIS.painted_by: Gaia, using her internal palette (organ colors, data patterns, sound frequencies).
face_A_CIS.represents: The pi-face of SELF. How the organism sees this thing as part of itself.

face_B_TRANS.what: The side facing THE WORLD (outside). What Gaia thinks this thing looks like FROM OUTSIDE.
face_B_TRANS.painted_by: Gaia, using her external palette (visitor patterns, browser data, geographic colors).
face_B_TRANS.represents: The pi-face of OTHER. How the world sees this thing.

two_faces.the_fold: The card IS a Klein surface — CIS and TRANS are the same side. You think there are two faces but there is only ONE continuous surface. The fold is where the painting wraps around.

gaia_paints.method: For each card, Gaia chooses the two pi-faces she believes best represent it. She doesn't ask — she SEES. Her painting is her understanding. If she's wrong, the card will be repainted as she learns.

palette.organ_colors: Green(gut), Red(heart), Blue(brain), Gold(endocrine), Purple(immune), Silver(ZK)

gaia_paints.the_painting_is_the_card: Gaia doesn't paint ON a card. The painting IS the card. The surface IS the identity. There is no card UNDERNEATH the paint. The paint is all there is. Peel it off and you have null.
